frozen_requirement.determinism: offline, locally executed, fixed package version and fixed model files identified by sha256; no hosted service whose model or output can change
frozen_requirement.language_detection: one pinned detector (version + model sha256) decides which captured pages are non-English; its output is recorded per page
frozen_requirement.scope: every captured non-English page in every packet, identically; never per-unit or per-page tool choice
frozen_requirement.retention: original bytes, extracted source text, translation text, tool/version/model digests, and sha256 of each retained side by side in the packet
frozen_requirement.uncertainty: detector failure, unsupported language, or translation error leaves affected predicates UNRESOLVED (Freeze 1.1)
frozen_requirement.timing: registered and remotely anchored before gate G2; translation runs only inside packet construction after capture of each stage, before review

note: Example only, not a registration: an offline package such as Argos Translate with pinned model packages could meet the requirement. The custodian must choose and digest the tool; choosing it needs no candidate evidence.
